jobs_results.description:
AI Research Intern – Lexsi Labs
Commitment: Full-time internship (6 months; potential extension or full-time offer)


Start Date: Rolling


About Lexsi Labs
Lexsi Labs is one of the leading frontier labs focusing on building aligned, interpretable and safe Superintelligence. Most of the work involves on creating new methodologies for efficient alignment, interpretability lead-strategies and tabular foundational model research. Our mission is to create AI tools that empower researchers, engineers, and organizations to unlock AI's full potential while maintaining transparency and safety.


Our team thrives on a shared passion for cutting-edge innovation, collaboration, and a relentless drive for excellence. At Lexsi.ai, everyone contributes hands-on to our mission in a flat organizational structure that values curiosity, initiative, and exceptional performance.


As a research intern at Lexsi.ai, you will be uniquely positioned in our team to work on very large-scale industry problems and push forward the frontiers of AI technologies. You will become a part of the unique atmosphere where startup culture meets research innovation, with key outcomes of speed and reliability.


What You’ll Do
We work on multiple frontier research ideas and challenges. If you are selected, you would be working on one of these following areas. Collaborate closely with our research and engineering teams on one of the areas:


Library Development: Architect and enhance open-source Python tooling for alignment, explainability, model alginment, uncertainty quantification, robustness, and machine unlearning
Explainability & Trust: Improve and find new observations using our and other SOTA XAI techniques (DLB, LRP, SHAP, Grad-CAM, Backtrace) across text, image, and tabular modalities to understand and present new model interpretability.
Mechanistic Interpretability: Probe internal model representations and circuits—using activation patching, feature visualization, and related methods—to diagnose failure modes and emergent behaviors.
Uncertainty & Risk: Develop, implement, and benchmark uncertainty estimation methods (Bayesian approaches, ensembles, test-time augmentation) alongside robustness metrics for foundation models.
Tabular Foundational Models (Orion): Work with our leading Tabular Foundational Model team to improve and launch new tabular foundational model architectures and work on our leading opesource library TabTune.
Reinforcement Learning: Explore new ideas and algorithm around RL and our new RL fine-tuning library.
Research Contributions: Author and maintain experiment code, run systematic studies, and co-author whitepapers or conference submissions.



General Required Qualifications
Strong Python expertise: writing clean, modular, and testable code.
Theoretical foundations: deep understanding of machine learning and deep learning principles with hands-on experience with PyTorch.
Transformer architectures & fundamentals: comprehensive knowledge of attention mechanisms, positional encodings, tokenization and training objectives in BERT, GPT, LLaMA, T5, MOE, Mamba, etc.
Version control & CI/CD: Git workflows, packaging, documentation, and collaborative development practices.
Collaborative mindset: excellent communication, peer code reviews, and agile teamwork.


Preferred Domain Expertise (Any one of these is good) :
Explainability: applied experience with XAI methods such as DLB, SHAP, LIME, IG, LRP, DL-Bactrace or Grad-CAM.
Mechanistic interpretability: familiarity with circuit analysis, activation patching, and feature visualization for neural network introspection.
Uncertainty estimation: hands-on with Bayesian techniques, ensembles, or test-time augmentation.
Quantization & pruning: applying model compression to optimize size, latency, and memory footprint.
LLM Alignment techniques: crafting and evaluating few-shot, zero-shot, and chain-of-thought prompts; experience with RLHF workflows, reward modeling, and human-in-the-loop fine-tuning.
Tabular Foundational Models: Should have used or improved TFMs like Orion, TabPFN, TabICL etc
Post-training adaptation & fine-tuning: practical work with full-model fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, adapters), instruction tuning, knowledge distillation, and domain-specialization.



Additional Experience (Nice-to-Have)
Publications: contributions to CVPR, ICLR, ICML, KDD, WWW, WACV, NeurIPS, ACL, NAACL, EMNLP, IJCAI or equivalent research experience.
Open-source contributions: prior work on AI/ML libraries or tooling.
Domain exposure: risk-sensitive applications in finance, healthcare, or similar fields.
Performance optimization: familiarity with large-scale training infrastructures.



What We Offer
Real-world impact: address high-stakes AI challenges in regulated industries.
Compute resources: access to GPUs, cloud credits, and proprietary models.
Competitive stipend: with potential for full-time conversion.
Authorship opportunities: co-authorship on papers, technical reports, and conference submissions.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Visiting the IIT Bombay campus during the monsoon is an unforgettable experience. The lush green surroundings, rain-soaked trees, peaceful lakes, and fresh air make the campus look like a paradise in the heart of Mumbai. Every corner feels vibrant and full of life, with beautiful architecture blending seamlessly into nature. Walking through the tree-lined roads while enjoying the cool drizzle is incredibly refreshing. The campus is well-maintained, serene, and offers the perfect balance of academic excellence and natural beauty. A must-visit place during the rainy season for anyone who appreciates peaceful and picturesque landscapes.
Visited to attend to my daughter's post graduation ceremony at the 64 th convocation. Visited the Industrial Research Centre and the auditorium. Also had apeek into the VR lab. Everything was Great.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ IIT Bombay, Powai
A sprawling green campus tucked beside Powai Lake — peaceful, beautiful, and surprisingly self-contained. Peacocks roam freely like they own the place (they probably do). World-class labs, a buzzing food court, and infrastructure that puts most small towns to shame. The academic energy is intense but the tree-lined walks balance it out perfectly. Monsoon transforms the whole place into something almost magical. Getting in as an outsider needs prior permission, which is a minor hassle. But if you ever get the chance to spend a day here, take it without thinking twice. One of Mumbai’s most underrated gems.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Visited IIT Bombay during Techfest, and honestly it was just…decent. For something that’s supposed to be the #1 institute in India, the experience didn’t really match the hype. They call it the “biggest techfest in Asia,” but even the projects and exhibitions were not exactly mind-blowing for a claim that big. A lot of it felt fairly normal rather than futuristic or genuinely impressive. If you’re branding it at that level, people are obviously going to expect way more.

One major issue was the management. There was a meetup with Kalki’s director where people had to wait in line for hours. When entry finally started, the hosting itself was quite underwhelming not very clear or engaging. And then, out of nowhere, there was a power cut in the auditorium for around 45 minutes, which was honestly surprising for a place of this level. It felt awkward overall, especially considering the guest and the expectations.

That said, the campus itself is big, green, and well maintained, and the library is impressive. But the event experience didn’t really live up to the reputation they promote.

It’s a memorable moment to enter into this IIT. It’s been a 5-month-long journey of NEC, and after that we secured the 156th rank in the Basic Track of the NEC Challenge, which itself is a proud achievement for us—especially because my college is new to these kinds of national-level challenges. Stepping into IIT Bombay after this journey felt unreal and deeply satisfying.

Attending E-SUMMIT 2K25 at IIT Bombay was nothing short of inspiring. From the moment we entered the campus, the environment itself motivated us to think bigger, dream bolder, and work harder. The infrastructure, innovation culture, and energy of the place clearly show why IIT Bombay is a global hub for entrepreneurship and technology.

The sessions, speaker talks, startup showcases, and interactions with entrepreneurs and mentors were extremely insightful. Listening to founders, investors, and industry leaders share their real-world experiences gave us clarity on how ideas turn into impactful startups. The exposure we gained here cannot be measured in words—it reshaped our mindset towards problem-solving, leadership, and innovation.

For a student coming from a college that is still growing in such ecosystems, this experience was truly empowering. Representing our institution at such a prestigious platform and standing among students from top colleges across the country gave us confidence and motivation to aim higher. The coordination, hospitality, and professionalism of the E-SUMMIT organizing team were excellent, making the entire event smooth and memorable.

Overall, IIT Bombay E-SUMMIT 2K25 was not just an event for us—it was a life-changing experience. It strengthened our belief that with consistency, teamwork, and vision, even students from new colleges can compete, learn, and grow on national platforms. This journey will remain a milestone in our academic and entrepreneurial life, and IIT Bombay will always hold a special place in our hearts.

⭐ Truly an unforgettable experience and a dream destination for every aspiring innovator and entrepreneur

Pre-process and tile the imagery according to model input requirements.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

Proficiency in Python, OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras; familiarity with

segmentation, and classification tasks.

 Interpersonal skills to enable working in a diverse and dynamic team.

 Writing and delivering technical documents and briefings. 

Verbal and written communication skills as well as organizational skills. 

Travel occasionally as necessary.
